subject: Final go/no-go: MAP signoff, eSign sequencing, and day-one plan
messages:
From: Jared Kim <jared@classicretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + timing — last mile questions before signature

Evelyn,

Thanks for getting us to the finish line on the MAP and evaluation notes. Two quick items from our side before we commit to signing:

- Can you confirm who will approve the final SOW (legal or sales ops) and whether signatures will be sequential or simultaneous?
- Our procurement team needs an eSign timeline and invoice/PO timing (they want to align the PO with the DocuSign envelope).
- Any hard constraints on start date — our rollout window opens Aug 17 but finance prefers invoices created by the signature date.

If we can lock this by early next week we can finalize the pilot kickoff.

Regards,
Jared Kim
Head of Platform Integrations
Classic Retail

Attachment: "MAP_for_Classic_v3.xlsx" (spreadsheet stub, 13KB)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared@classicretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + timing — last mile questions before signature

Jared — thanks, and appreciate the tight timeline. Short answer: legal approval (internal) then DocuSign envelope (simultaneous signing preferred), invoice prior to signature is workable. Proposed final sequence below: 

Proposed close/runbook (please confirm):

1) Wednesday Aug 12 EOD — Redwood legal to sign off on SOW redlines (Karthik will send summary)
2) Thursday Aug 13 09:00 PT — Send DocuSign envelope (simultaneous signing for both parties)
3) Thursday Aug 13 by 17:00 PT — Expected signed copies back (we'll chase)
4) Friday Aug 14 — Redwood issues invoice (net 30 terms as discussed)
5) Monday Aug 17 — Target first-day access & onboarding (onboarding calendar to be shared)

A few clarifications / asks from our side:
- We have a single minor SLA tweak suggestion (data retention window) — Karthik will include a one-paragraph amendment; it should not block signatures.
- Please confirm your finance contact for the invoice so we can notify billing.
- I'll attach the SOW draft and the MAP that reflects the evaluation milestones we agreed on.

If that sequence works for you, we'll treat Aug 13 as our go/no-go signature day. If procurement needs the invoice earlier we can move invoice creation up to the morning of Aug 13 but prefer issuing after signatures for clean PO matching — open to your preference.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: "SOW_Draft_CR-5493.pdf" (PDF stub, 78KB), "Classic_MAP_v3.xlsx" (spreadsheet stub, 13KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared@classicretail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + timing — last mile questions before signature

Evelyn / team — quick legal readout: I reviewed the SOW redlines and the MAP milestones. We're comfortable with all changes except one small item:

- Request to formalize data retention default to 30 days for KV/prefix cache logs in the SOW (we'll include an opt-in appendix for 90-day retention if required by their security team).

This is a non-blocker for the commercial signoff, but I want to be explicit so Procurement isn't surprised. I'll attach a one-page redline summary and the exact contract language we propose. If Classic confirms the 30-day default (or signs the appendix), legal gives a green light.

I can be on the call Thu morning for the DocuSign send if needed.

— Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: "Legal_Redline_Summary.docx" (doc stub, 6KB)
From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@classicretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jared Kim <jared@classicretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + timing — last mile questions before signature

Thanks — that sequence looks good. A few notes from procurement/finance at Classic Retail: 

- Procurement needs the invoice to be visible to their PO system before they finalize the PO number. Can Redwood issue a preliminary invoice (draft) on Thu morning Aug 13 upon DocuSign send? A final invoice with signed copies can follow after signatures.
- On the data retention item: we can accept the 30-day default if Redwood provides the appendix for a 90-day opt-in. Please include the appendix language in the DocuSign envelope or as a separate addendum.
- We need the DocuSign envelope link and the person who will initiate the send. Also — Finance will require an ACH payment instruction on the invoice; can you include that?
- Slight request on start date: to ensure internal teams can staff the pilot properly, can we shift the first-day access to Tue Aug 18 (one business day later)? If that works for you, we'll lock resources on our side.

If you can confirm the DocuSign sender and include the legal appendix, we'll be ready to proceed on Aug 13.

Best,
Arielle Thompson
Sr. Procurement Manager
Classic Retail
